title: Generic trivialization of a finite-coefficient sheaf by a finite normal cover
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian excellent integral scheme [def-exc-excellent-ring, def-pc-integral-scheme], let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $F$ be a constructible sheaf of $A_X$-modules on the ordinary small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There exist a finite surjective morphism $f:Y\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], a nonempty open subscheme $U\subseteq X$, and a finite $A$-module $N$ such that $Y$ is integral and normal (its local rings are integrally closed domains [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]), $f^{-1}U\to U$ is finite etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $(f^*F)|_{f^{-1}U}\cong\underline N_{f^{-1}U}$ as sheaves of $A$-modules. Here $f^*$ is ordinary inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and $\underline N$ is the constant module sheaf. No finite-type hypothesis over a field is imposed.
